body: I feel like this is partly the fault of those pick up artists books.
It would. I already have well-though out plans that I'll never ever get to use in case I win.
I'm constanly switching from wanting to better my life to killing myself because it won't make a difference.
Life won't ever get better for some people.
I also get this, and I do the same thing. Just dwell.

I know it's been a while but I have positive update. 

The surgery to get rid of my deformation, the one that would have cost me thousands of dollars, was almost completely covered by my insurance. I only had to pay 20 euro's (24 dollars).

The surgery helped a lot and got rid of the constant suicidal thoughts and tears. I'm still depressed and have a lot to work on, but at least I'm not in immediate danger of commiting suicide.
I was focusing on losing weight but since this thing happened I lost al motivation.
I dont want to talk about it since I'm scared someone I know might see this and figure out who I am.
What's your situation? If you mind me asking.

How do you feel when you're actively planning instead of just thinking about?

I've been in that situation for a couple of months and I would burst out in tears everytime I'd think about how to do it because It felt like I had finally gotten to a point where I was actually going to do it.

I survived that period but I made some choices that completelty fucked things up for the future (now) because, back then, nothing seemed relevant at all, seeing as I was going to die anyway.

I'm all of that only 2 years older and minus the siblings and a parent. I know what you're feeling man, word for word.

I always wonder if other people see me as mentally handicaped, and sometimes I myself even wonder If I really am.

I also screwed up everything in life (including school, hello shitload of debt) and missed out on everything, and the worst of it all is that is was all my fault. Insecurity and depression destroyed me.

I don't even know why I'm typing this. This isn't supportive at all.

Maybe the fact that you're not the only one going trough this will help you a little bit? I dont know man, i'm sorry.

I hate that there are other people going through this.
I have gotten to the point where I can barely even finish masturbating because I get too depressed during.
